chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Women were mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so he said: 'Disobey them in what is good (al-ma'ruf) before they command you to do what is evil (al-munkar), and seek refuge with Allah from their evil ones, and be cautious regarding their good ones.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of disobeying women in 'al-ma'ruf' before they command 'al-munkar'?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) advises men to maintain a stance of 'disobedience' or independence in matters of goodness (al-ma'ruf) to preserve their moral agency before women might command them toward evil (al-munkar). This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on mutual moral accountability, where men are urged to seek refuge from the 'evil' of women's potential to lead them astray while remaining vigilant against the 'good' that may become a source of distraction or subtle deviation.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The women were mentioned to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, so he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Disobey them regarding the good before they enjoin you for the evil, and seek Refuge with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from their evil ones, and become cautious from their good ones’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that women were mentioned before the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,

and he (the Messenger of Allah) said, ’Disobey women in lawful matters before they command you to do unlawful acts and you must seek refuge with Allah against the wicked women and remain on your guard with the good ones of them.’”
